confidence_notes: Beer and cappuccino anchors are well supported: several 2026 Seoul aggregators (Expatistan, CityCost, Whereandwhen, Numbeo-derived listings) agree closely. The inexpensive meal and mid-range meal anchors draw on a Korea Consumer Agency-based survey and aggregator figures, which are less precise. Cocktail is less certain: sources range from about 12,000 to 25,000 won, and the anchor sits in the upper-middle of that range. Wine_glass is the least certain drink; no current city-wide average was found, so it is inferred from scattered undated venue prices and the local beer relationship. Won-to-USD conversion assumes roughly 1,460 KRW per USD, taken from a secondary July 2026 blog figure rather than a verified current rate, so USD values could shift. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and Seoul context; no accommodation searches were run and no booking pages or current listings were inspected. For FX, the 0.6947 value for 2026-10-16 was read from a search snippet of the RBA exchange-rates page, not from the full F11.1 table. The same snippet showed a 15 October figure of 0.6955 and an age label, so the 16 October observation is not fully verified.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors are Seoul-specific, based on the aggregator and survey figures above. Accommodation anchors reflect general knowledge of Seoul's hostel and registered guesthouse and hotel tiers.
